name: param-miner
description: Discovers hidden request parameters and unkeyed inputs on one request you pick: common query, body and cookie parameter names, and the proxy, routing and caching headers that matter behind a CDN or load balancer (the inputs that change a response without being part of its cache key). A right-click action only — it never runs on its own. It guesses names against the request you chose, judges each by whether its value reflects or the response changes from a baseline, bisects a reacting batch to the name responsible, and confirms every candidate on its own before recording it, so an unconfirmed guess is never reported. Active and can be noisy; every probe carries a cache-buster so it never shares a cache key with a real user, and the plugin discovers unkeyed inputs rather than attempting cache poisoning.

actions.label: Param Miner
actions.description: Guess hidden query parameters and request headers for this request, and record each one the server accepts as a finding. Sends many requests to this host (active); every probe carries a cache-buster so nothing is cached on others' behalf.

settings.label: Where to mine
settings.description: Which parts of the request to guess names in: query, header, body, cookie. The default is query and header — header is where the CDN/load-balancer unkeyed inputs live. Body is only mined when the request has a form or JSON body.

settings.label: Extra names to guess
settings.description: Names added to the bundled list (parameter names for query/body/cookie, header names for header). Use it to add names particular to your target.

settings.label: Most requests to send
settings.description: A hard cap on the probes one run sends, across every location, including baseline, bisection and confirmation. The run stops when it is reached.

settings.label: Names per request
settings.description: How many names are guessed in one probe. Larger is faster but makes a reacting batch costlier to bisect; smaller is gentler.

settings.label: Pause between requests (ms)
settings.description: A pause before each probe, so a run doesn't burst at the target or its CDN.

settings.label: Most parameters to report
settings.description: The run stops recording once this many parameters are confirmed.

settings.label: Baseline samples
settings.description: How many times the unmodified request is sent first, to learn the response's normal status and length before a guess is judged against it.

settings.label: Largest response scanned for reflection (KiB)
settings.description: Only this much of each response body is searched for a reflected canary value. The body length, used to spot a response that changed, is measured in full.
